compiled_state.title: S_docs.T3: Emit DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block on S_docs completion report
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: doc-router.md gates run for each documentation target; DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block attached to this ticket's completion report.

## Implementation Notes

After T1 (ADR) and T2 (audit + HOOKS update) complete, emit a DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION ticket comment on this story summarizing:
- Each target file modified.
- Which doc-router gate (1-5) fired for each target.
- Verdict per target (modified | created | no-change-required | CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE).

Format:
```
DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION:
- docs/adr/<N>-version-bump-design.md: Gate 4 fired (decision rationale); created.
- plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md: Gate 2 fired (existing reference doc); modified by S3.T5 + S4.T5 + S7.T10 + S_mig.T10 + S_docs.T2 cross-link audit.
- plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md: Gate 2 fired; modified by S6.T6.
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md: Gate 2 fired; modified by S7.T10.
- plugins/dso/docs/HOOKS-REFERENCE.md: Gate 2 fired; <modified|no-change-required>.
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/cycle-ledger.md: Gate 2 fired; modified by S2.T11.
- CLAUDE.md: <CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE | no-change-required> per Gate 5.
```

## File Impact
No source file changes. Output is a structured ticket comment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION comment exists on S_docs ticket
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show cdc0-8cfc-38e6-4e7d 2>&1 | grep -q 'DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION'
- [ ] Attestation lists all 5+ doc targets
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show cdc0-8cfc-38e6-4e7d 2>&1 | grep -cE 'CI-INTEGRATION|WORKTREE-GUIDE|CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE|HOOKS-REFERENCE|cycle-ledger|adr.*version' | awk '{exit ($1>=4?0:1)}'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
